clearDepositRateManager(address,uint256).details: Only the depositor can clear. Reverts if escrow is paused.      Emits DepositRateManagerCleared with the previous registry and manager id.

getDepositRateManager(address,uint256).details: Returns (address(0), 0) if the deposit has not opted into a manager.

getEffectiveMinRate(address,uint256,byte.details: If no manager is set, returns the depositor floor. If manager disables the pair      (min rate = 0) or payment method is inactive, returns 0. Reverts if a manager      is set but the registry address is missing.

returns._0: minRate       Effective minimum conversion rate in precise units.

getManagerFee(address,uint256).details: Returns (address(0), 0) if no manager is set. Reverts if a manager      is set but the registry address is missing.

setDepositRateManager(address,uint256,ad.details: Only the depositor can opt in. Reverts if escrow is paused, inputs are zero,      a manager is already set, or the rate manager id is not registered. If a manager      hook is configured, it is called (view) and may revert to reject the opt-in.

clearDepositRateManager(address,uint256).notice: Clear the rate manager for a deposit.

getDepositRateManager(address,uint256).notice: Returns the stored (registry, rateManagerId) for a deposit.

getEffectiveMinRate(address,uint256,byte.notice: Returns the effective minimum conversion rate for a deposit/currency pair.

getManagerFee(address,uint256).notice: Returns the manager fee recipient and fee for a deposit.

setDepositRateManager(address,uint256,ad.notice: Opt a deposit into a rate manager configuration.

userdoc.notice: External controller that stores per-deposit rate manager config and computes effective min rates.
